correctness.rationale: For all n>=3, integer cycle circulation on the prism is generated by n squares and one rim; the transfer zero coefficient counts precisely these flat forms. The 2016 general GHM synchronization criterion identifies them with extinction. Direct exact symbolic characteristic differentiation proves the Perron eigenvalue and variance, and the explicit weight-zero self-loop and weight-one three-cycle force uniqueness of the Fourier saddle. Gaussian integration then proves the asymptotic. The packaged checker exhausts n=3,4,5,6 and independent symbolic code reproduces the 9x9 identities. Finite tests do not prove the infinite assertion by themselves.

value.rationale: The uniform-start extinction probability is a canonical and motivated dynamical invariant for the full infinite family of width-two cyclic excitable networks. Unlike merely evaluating a small case, the result identifies an exact family-wide coefficient count, simple algebraic exponential decay, and a topologically forced n^{-1/2} correction from the surviving rim winding; these calculations are unavailable from the qualitative source without further nontrivial enumeration and spectral analysis.
